# Mistakes by area

<!-- Generated by `python .github/scripts/mistakes.py render` from the lessons' `areas:` front matter and the rows of
the corrections page: edit those, not this page. -->

Read the sections of your task's areas before you start: each line is a mistake we already made and the check that
would have caught it. A lesson names its areas in front matter (`areas: [net, web]`; the names are in
[areas.toml](../lessons/areas.toml)); a corrections row without a lesson is placed by keyword. `gds issue start` records
an issue's areas from its labels and the hooks put these sections into the agent's context; `gds lessons <area>` prints
one.

## general

Anything that fits no other area. (4)

| Mistake | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A "never the same as the day before" rotation needs a chain with a start | anchor the chain per 30-day block: the block's first day picks without the rule, and each later day is computed from the block's start, so the work per day is bounded. | [lesson](../lessons/2026-11-02-a-not-the-day-before-rotation-needs-an-anchor.md) |
| Bare `cat > file` in a shell command hung the tool for two minutes | write files with the Write tool, or give every `cat >` a heredoc; check each step of a chain printed. | [lesson](../lessons/2026-11-01-bare-cat-redirect-hung-the-shell.md) |
| We assumed the starter kit was enough content | Inventory the starter kit against the game's needs and plan the gaps as art tasks | [row](maintainer-corrections.md#corrections-and-the-checks-they-become) |
| Hold-to-interact is the genre's convention for repeated actions | For each interaction decide press or hold against the reference and write it in the design | [row](maintainer-corrections.md#found-by-playing-concepts-and-details-we-missed) |
